source.note: RecBole's processed S3 URL returned HTTP 403 here. Atomic files were converted from the official GroupLens ratings.dat, movies.dat, and users.dat with scripts/convert_movielens_1m.py.

protocol.split_method: dataset.build() — same 8:1:1 split as training; no model was trained.
protocol.seed_note: init_seed(2020, True) is called before dataset.build() because eval_args.order is RO (shuffle then cut). Without that call the item slices are not reproducible.

train_split.note: Cold is a natural count on the training split only (threshold 5). Padding id 0 is excluded. This is not a graded metric table.

decision.headline: rarely seen items on ml-1m
decision.detail: The group chose to headline the ml-1m cold analysis on items with <= 5 training edges (372) and to report items with zero training edges (28) as a separate slice. Natural cold users (2) are logged only and are not a result table. The 18-user truncated browser cohort is not reused.
